Grafaiai

Poison Normal

Paldea · Generation 9

Grafaiai is a Poison/Normal-type Toxic Monkey Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 27.2 kg. It evolves from Shroodle. Its highest base stat is Speed (110), with a base stat total of 485.
